remarks: This beautifully maintained two-bedroom townhouse offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience within the sought-after Greenway Condominium community. Spanning three levels of living space, the home welcomes you with a bright open-concept main floor featuring brand-new hardwood floors, fresh paint, and generous natural light throughout.  The kitchen boasts granite countertops, stainless steel appliances (including a wine refrigerator), and an easy flow into the dining and living areas - ideal for everyday living and entertaining. A convenient half bath completes the main level.  Upstairs, you'll find two spacious bedrooms, including a primary suite with a walk-in closet, along with an updated full bath featuring modern tilework, new fixtures, and vanity. The finished lower level offers exceptional flexibility - perfect for a family room, home office, or gym - and includes a walk-out to the rear patio plus in-unit laundry.  Additional highlights include an attached garage, an exterior parking space, and access to Greenway's professionally managed grounds and in-ground pool. Conveniently located just minutes from shopping, Metro-North, and I-95, this home combines low-maintenance living with an unbeatable Stamford location.
